name: app-shahyti-food-delivery-app-cover-red-with-script-overlay
title: Shahyti food delivery app cover with giant red caps, yellow script overlay and three phones
whatItIs: A cream cover with huge red 'SHAHYTI' caps overlapped by a yellow handwritten 'Food delivery app', and three phones: a home screen with 'Spin & win', a red welcome screen with fried chicken and fries, and a restaurant menu screen, with yellow sparkle doodles.
whatItMeans: Hungry and fun; the red and yellow fast-food palette and script feel lively and local.
techniques: Overlap a script tagline across bold caps.
Put the splash screen in the centre phone.

vocabulary.definition: The first branded screen when an app opens.
Handwritten text layered across other type.
